name: No Factory Passengers
summary: The line editor no longer turns on passenger loading on lines that can carry cargo.
description: The line editor no longer turns on passenger loading on lines that can load cargo at any stop (a cargo station with an industry or warehouse in reach). Passenger-only lines, such as bus lines, keep passengers.
